name: Bitbucket
description: Bitbucket Cloud is a Git hosting and code-collaboration service built around repositories, pull requests, and issue tracking. Software teams use it to review changes, coordinate development, and manage source code in shared workspaces.
agentUseSummary: Connect Bitbucket once, then choose which agents may find repositories, read issues and pull requests, prepare comments, or post comments under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Find repositories
capabilities.description: Search up to twenty-five repositories visible to the authorized Bitbucket user.

capabilities.label: Read issues
capabilities.description: List up to fifty issues from one explicit Bitbucket repository.

capabilities.label: Read pull requests
capabilities.description: List up to fifty pull requests from one explicit Bitbucket repository.

capabilities.label: Prepare comments
capabilities.description: Prepare one bounded issue or pull-request comment locally without changing Bitbucket.

capabilities.label: Comment on issues
capabilities.description: Post one exact comment to an explicit Bitbucket issue.

capabilities.label: Comment on pull requests
capabilities.description: Post one exact comment to an explicit Bitbucket pull request.

allowed.label: Search repositories
allowed.description: Search a bounded set of repositories visible to the authorized Bitbucket user.

allowed.label: List issues
allowed.description: List a bounded set of issues in one explicit Bitbucket repository.

allowed.label: List pull requests
allowed.description: List a bounded set of pull requests in one explicit Bitbucket repository.

allowed.label: Prepare a comment
allowed.description: Prepare one issue or pull-request comment locally without changing Bitbucket.

approvalRequired.label: Comment on an issue
approvalRequired.description: Post one exact comment to an explicit Bitbucket issue; Safe mode requires matching approval.

approvalRequired.label: Comment on a pull request
approvalRequired.description: Post one exact comment to an explicit Bitbucket pull request; Safe mode requires matching approval.

blocked.label: Administer repositories or workspaces
blocked.description: Repository, project, workspace, member, permission, and branch-restriction administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change pipelines
blocked.description: Pipeline runs, variables, deployments, runners, and other CI/CD mutations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change repository contents
blocked.description: Branches, tags, files, merges, pushes, forks, and repository deletion are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Bitbucket API calls
blocked.description: Raw URLs, arbitrary operations, tokens, and unbounded pagination are never exposed to agents.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Repository searches, bounded reads, and local drafts run directly; each posted comment requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Bitbucket operation supported by this connector runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, Bitbucket user authority, request bounds, audits, redaction, and Bitbucket limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts six typed Bitbucket tools and attaches the connected user's token server-side without exposing it to the agent.
Railway mounts six typed Bitbucket tools and attaches the connected user's token server-side without exposing it to the agent.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console's Bitbucket OAuth consumer, production callback, scopes, client credentials, and a fresh production authorization have not been configured and verified.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a Bitbucket Cloud OAuth consumer in the Relay Console workspace, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/bitbucket/callback, grant account, repository, pullrequest, and issue, configure BITBUCKET_CLIENT_ID and BITBUCKET_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then verify state, user binding, refresh-token rotation, bounded reads, Safe comment approval, Dangerous comment posting, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Atlassian documents workspace-owned OAuth consumers, exact callback configuration, authorization-code exchange, two-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, fixed consumer scopes, and bearer authentication.
Bitbucket documents OAuth scopes account, repository, pullrequest, and issue; refresh-token rotation and three-month unused refresh expiry; bearer-token API access; and bounded paginated resources.
Bitbucket documents repository listing and filtering; Relay restricts results to page one and twenty-five shaped records.
Bitbucket documents repository issue listing and comment creation; Relay wraps one explicit repository and bounded page-one results.
Bitbucket documents pull-request listing and comment creation; Relay exposes only shaped reads and one exact comment mutation.
Bitbucket removed OAuth token query/body authentication and standardized the token response scope field in May 2026; Relay uses Authorization bearer headers and accepts the current scope field.
